profile.name: Muhammad Abdullah Jamal
profile.tagline: I turn complex data into actionable insights using Python, SQL, Power BI, and Machine Learning.
profile.bio: I'm a Data Analyst and Computer Science graduate who turns raw, messy data into dashboards, models, and decisions that hold up in production. My day-to-day is Python, SQL, Power BI, and regex-driven cleaning pipelines, and I'm currently deepening my Machine Learning and Data Science skills toward a Data Scientist / ML Engineer role. Alongside analytics, I build the full-stack apps and admin tools that put that data to work, in React, Node.js, and Next.js.
